frequency_question: How often do major energy/infrastructure reform bills successfully pass with specific streamlining provisions for interstate projects within the designated legislative window?
membership_rule: Includes major bipartisan or reconciliation energy packages explicitly targeting permitting or infrastructure approvals; excludes narrow single-agency technical corrections.

cases.name: Energy Independence and Security Act of 2007

provenance_note: 5 cases named, 7 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.4x)
coverage_note: 5 named major legislative vehicles; 2 failed comprehensive attempts included in total denominator (e.g., 2010 energy bill collapse, 2022 Manchin permitting reform failure).
known_gaps: Excludes minor rider amendments attached to appropriations without standalone debate.
skeleton: Total major energy/infrastructure packages enacted containing permitting provisions divided by total major omnibus attempts
multiplier: 5 hits out of 7 major attempts where comprehensive energy permitting was actively negotiated
validity_reason: Gridlock dynamics and congressional procedures remain stable across standard congressional sessions.
